scope: static closure review ONLY ALIAS-GEOMETRY-EMPTY; no tests/project runtime/Native/JVM/old audit executed

closure.reason: Each pad and copper-bearing field/graphic uses source-derived required Cu layer keys; empty map or missing required layer fails. Ordinary shape maps require nonempty polygon lists.
Every retained outer/hole ring requires at least three integer-nanometre vertices; empty polygon outer geometry fails.

Zone outline must remain nonempty. Fill maps require every source zone Cu layer; empty per-layer derived containers are allowed only without sourcefilled_polygon on that layer, while sourcefilled layers require nonempty Native fill.
Copper glyph and area outlines require nonempty bounded point populations.

limits: Only the last concrete empty-geometry finding is closed. No new general whole-core or electrical-geometry certificate is asserted.
The recorded census004 is a lead-produced pure check of retained actual during/restored payloads; this review only reads its immutable result and source binding.
Fresh current normal Native routing/export/cancellation compatibility and integration tests remain separate gates.
